messages:
ana: Quick thread to lock down HW+SaaS private-offer pilot details: commit tiers, SI credits, launch cadence, and fallback pricing. Need alignment by EOW.

rajesh: Customer A wants a 12mo commit with a 3-month ramp. Thinking of front-loaded discount to help adoption. Thoughts?

kevin: Front-load makes sense for adoption. Proposal: 25% effective discount for months 1-3, then 12% for months 4-12. That balances NPV and churn risk.

claire: Ops note 1: marketplace listings often reject variable discount text. We should translate to explicit SKU tiers.

ana: Agreed. Draft SKU matrix below for marketplace ops review: 
```
SKU: APPL-HW-SW-CORE
Tiers (annual commit): 60k, 180k, 360k
Price model: staged discount (25% Q1, 12% Q2-Q4) -> represented as TierA/TierB prices in marketplace listing
Minimum monthly floor: 20% of annualized tier
Grace: 45-day catch-up window before post-commit adjustment
```
Can ops confirm whether 2-tier price fields are allowed?

kevin: Finance run looked ok with those floors. Also recommend an auto-convert option: if customer stabilizes above floor for 2 consecutive months, allow retroactive conversion to next tier and apply corresponding discount credit.

rajesh: For SI economics, propose a two-part enablement: 
- $10k one-time onboarding credit applied to first invoice for certified SI attachments
- $2k success fee payable after deployment milestones (two milestones)
This keeps credits tied to outcomes.

claire: Legal redline: credits must be non-transferable, expire after 6 months, and limited to first 3 deals per SI partner. Also avoid using "refund" language.

ana: We should add renewal conversion language so unused credits don't create disputes. Suggest: unused onboarding credits roll into a renewal discount pool if customer opts into renewal within 90 days. Require explicit consent checkbox on renewal flow.

ops-bot: ticket_create: "Marketplace SKU - APPL-HW-SW-CORE two-tier pricing approval". Ticket #45211 created. Assignees: claire, ops. Due: 2024-05-18.

kevin: Marketing needs co-announcement copy freeze 10 business days pre-listing. Also request 5 localized deck templates for field.

rajesh: Timeline proposal: pilot start 2024-05-20, pilot end 2024-07-20, marketplace listing target 2024-08-05. Any blockers?

claire: Legal can sign off by 2024-05-16 if we keep credit language conservative. I'll post redlines in the ticket.

ana: Action items:
- kevin: upload SKU pricing spreadsheet to ticket #45211 by 2024-05-14
- rajesh: SI credit T&Cs draft by 2024-05-13
- claire: legal redlines and marketplace fields confirmation by 2024-05-16
- ops: confirm marketplace two-price-field support and listing constraints by 2024-05-15
- marketing: co-announcement asset templates by 2024-07-20

ops-bot: reminder_set: Ticket #45211 reminder on 2024-05-15.

ana: One more discussion point: post-commit adjustment language for customers that under-deliver. Proposal: after 45-day grace, apply a 12% post-commit reconciliation on shortfall, or allow conversion to a lower-tier with pro-rated price. Use term "post-commit consumption adjustment" in outward-facing docs.

kevin: Good. Prefer reconciliation to be presented as "adjustment" not fee. Also build an internal playbook for mid-term tier conversions to minimize disputes.

rajesh: I'll coordinate SI enablement sessions and the first two pilot customers. Thanks all.

ana: Thanks team 1 I'll consolidate and share the pilot brief and the action-tracked PRD later today.
